sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: AI agents, MCP servers, and LLM apps break the core AppSec assumption that applications do what their code says. This guide walks through a practical see-fix-protect framework: a five-layer agentic AI attack surface map, a 12-point misconfiguration checklist, an evidence-based triage matrix, runtime guardrails, and system prompt hardening — plus a maturity self-assessment aligned to NIST AI RMF, OWASP AIMA, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act. The post How to Secure AI Agents, MCP Servers, and LLM Apps in Production appeared first on MarkTechPost .
